excluded.COSY: spectrum acquired but not curated: all 19 protonated carbons are olefinic/aromatic CH crowded into 5.9-8.0 ppm, and the magnitude-mode COSY is dominated by t1 streaks along every strong 1H column plus a broad diagonal ridge; distinct off-diagonal cross-peaks cannot be separated from streak/diagonal artifacts with any confidence, so none are recorded rather than risk invented peaks.
excluded.HMBC: unprocessable: non-uniformly sampled (FnTYPE=2, NUS 25%) with no nuslist in the deposit, so the spectrum cannot be reconstructed.

notes: Flavoaffinin: fully conjugated, no sp3 CH; strong aliphatic negative peaks at ~1.2-2.1/20-30 ppm in HSQC are residual acetone-d6 (2.05/29.8) and grease/impurity, not the compound. All real HSQC contours are positive (CH), 6.0-7.9 ppm / 98-137 ppm. HSQC is heavily overlapped in the polyene envelope (6.2-6.5 / 129-137); the recorded set is the confidently-distinct subset (~16-18 of 17 expected distinct protonated carbons) - a couple of overlapping polyene CH are unresolved. Only assignment given: indole C7-H at 7.34/111.7 (atom 30). 1H reference correction -0.145; edited-HSQC signs reliable.
